name: Amber Paradox
intro: An endless dual-timeline reflex game. The screen splits into an Amber track and a Void track, and your input only ever controls the active timeline. Tap Paradox Switch to flip control between them, dodge barriers, and collect Amber Cores and Overlap Cores as the scroll speed keeps climbing.
introZh: 无尽双时间线反应类游戏。画面分为上方的琥珀时间线与下方的虚空时间线，操作始终只作用于当前激活的那条；点击「悖论切换」交换控制权，躲避障碍并收集琥珀核心与重叠核心，滚动速度会随距离不断提升。

name: Twilight Sentinel
intro: A dusk-defense arcade game. Hold the line against spreading spores: purify zones, seal corruption nodes, and draft an upgrade between waves before the next bloom lands. Score chases a moving difficulty curve rather than a fixed level cap.
introZh: 暮色防御街机玩法。守住阵线对抗扩散的孢子：净化区域、封印腐化节点，每波之间抽取一次升级。难度随分数持续爬升，没有固定关卡上限。
